name: Chiribiquete National Park – “The Maloca of the Jaguar”
description: Deep in the Colombian Amazon, Chiribiquete is the country's largest national park and the world's largest tropical rainforest park, covering about 43,000 km². Sheer-sided sandstone tabletop mountains rise above the jungle. Their rock shelters hold more than 75,000 paintings of hunts, dances and jaguars, some thousands of years old. The site is closed to visitors, as it is sacred to Indigenous peoples.
